title: Reference identity and exclusion
when_to_use: Use when a Seedance video task requires reference identity and exclusion; this candidate is for explicit inspection only.
method: Give each reference a stable identifier. For each, describe the exact attributes to preserve and those explicitly excluded (including pose, background or lighting when not needed). Set a persistent subject/product lock and check head turns, occlusion, or motion for drift.
failure_modes: Copying an unintended background or pose
verification: Candidate; no real Seedance output validation. Do not auto-activate.
